title: Practice: How long, how long ago, how old

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: «Expressions referring to age are rendered in Russian as follows: Сколько вам лет? Мне двадцать лет. The person whose age is in question is in the dative case.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The person whose age is in question is in the dative case. (DLI, Lesson 41)

exercises.prompt: I lived in Vancouver for two months.
exercises.why: «In expressions answering the questions „How long?“ and „How long ago?“ the accusative case is used: Я был там год. Я был там месяц. Я был там неделю.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: “How long?” — the accusative, with no preposition. (DLI, Lesson 41)

exercises.prompt: I have a reservation for two nights.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last. (DLI, Lesson 73)

exercises.q: Она десять ___ (год) была охранницей в тюрьме.
exercises.prompt: She was a prison guard for ten years.
exercises.why: «For the genitive plural of the noun год the word лет is used: один год, два года, пять лет.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: For the genitive plural of год the word лет is used. (DLI, Lesson 41)
